paras: Monopeltis perplexus is a species of amphisbaenian in the family Amphisbaenidae. The species is endemic to Angola.
The preferred natural habitat of M. perplexus is unknown.
Small and slender for its genus, M. perplexus may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 30 cm (12 in). The tail is relatively long, greater than 10% SVL.
The mode of reproduction of M. perplexus is unknown.
